desc.id: Target masuk status Remora selama {0} detik setelah Esper Cycle terpicu: kecepatan gerak dan serangannya turun. Efeknya memudar seiring waktu dan durasinya makin pendek bila diterapkan berulang.
desc.en: The target enters Remora for {0}s after triggering Esper Cycle, slowing their movement and attack speed. The effect decays over time, and will have a shorter duration if repeatedly applied.

desc.id:
Memunculkan {0} Vita Bud di dekat target setelah Esper Cycle terpicu, yang mekar menjadi {1} Vita Pistil.
Vita Pistil lalu terbang ke target dalam jangkauan, meledak setiap {2} detik dan memberi DMG area.
Maksimal {3} Vita Bud ada di lapangan sekaligus.
desc.en:
Generates {0} Vita Bud near the target after triggering Esper Cycle, which blossoms {1} Vita Pistils.
Vita Pistils then fly toward targets within range, exploding every {2}s and dealing DMG to an area.
Up to {3} Vita Buds can exist on the field at once.

desc.id: Memberi satu hit Follow-up Attack DMG tambahan pada target sebesar {1} dari Anima atau Incantation DMG yang diterimanya dalam {0} detik setelah Esper Cycle terpicu.
desc.en: Deals an additional instance of follow-up attack DMG to the target equal to {1} of Anima or Incantation DMG taken within {0}s after triggering Esper Cycle.

desc.id: Menerapkan Nova pada target selama {0} detik setelah Esper Cycle terpicu. Saat efeknya berakhir, target menerima Mental Damage besar.
desc.en: Inflicts Nova on the target for {0}s after triggering Esper Cycle. When the effect ends, the target takes massive Mental Damage.

desc.id: Saat Esper Cycle terpicu, target terkena Scorch selama {0} detik dan menerima DoT.
desc.en: Upon triggering Esper Cycle, inflicts Scorch on the target for {0}s, dealing DoT.

desc.id: Setelah Esper Cycle terpicu, Psyche dan Lakshana DMG yang diterima target naik {1} selama {0} detik.
desc.en: Increases the target's Psyche and Lakshana DMG taken by {1} for {0}s after triggering Esper Cycle.

desc.id: Karakter yang sedang aktif mendapat {0} Ultimate Energy tambahan saat Vita Pistil mengenai target yang terkena Remora.
desc.en: Grants the active character {0} additional Ultimate Energy when Vita Pistils hit targets affected by Remora.

desc.id: Mengurangi sebagian Break target saat target terkena Nova dan Scorch sekaligus.
desc.en: Deducts a percentage of the target's Break when they are simultaneously affected by Nova and Scorch.
